correctness.rationale: Independently re-executed the exact-QQ Hochster pipeline (inputs/artifacts/verify_method.py) for all 7 edge lists from DRAFT.md. All 7 Betti tables reproduce byte-for-byte: G1 (10v, 20e) reg2/pd8, G2 (8v,16e) reg1/pd6 linear, G3 reg2/pd5, G4 reg2/pd7, G5 reg2/pd7, H reg2/pd5, H+e reg3/pd6. Euler/Hilbert identity K(t)=E(t) holds exactly for all 7 (euler_ok True). Induced-matching numbers re-verified by independent brute-force enumeration (itertools combinations with conflict check), confirming im=1,1,2,2,1,2,3 with witnesses as claimed; each witness checked to be induced (no cross edges). Reg/pdim read-offs (max j-i, max i) verified from tables. Calibration C5 -> (1,2)^5,(2,3)^5,(3,5)^1 reg2 and P3 -> linear reproduce textbook values; G2 linearity consistent with Froberg (chordal). Method uses Hochster's theorem (not literal Buchberger/Schreyer logs as in audit plan) but DRAFT honestly discloses this; Hochster over QQ with exact Fraction homology yields the minimal Betti numbers, so the certificate-form substitution does not invalidate the numbers. Stored tables.json contains only G1-G5; H/H+e tables were reproduced from DRAFT edge lists and verified, closing the gap by recomputation.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison (not timestamp): Jacques thesis (math/0410107) gives Betti/pdim only for forests and cycles via recursion - none of G1-G5,H,H+e (C5 blow-ups, chordal K5-attachment, whiskered C5, 9v intermediaries, jump pair) lies in those families. Anand-Roy (2007.02401) gives N-graded Betti/reg/pdim/im only for three dense circulant families; candidate graphs are sparse non-circulant (20,16,8,13,16,9,10 edges) and per-ideal tables plus jump pair are absent. Nguyen-Vu (1506.05769) classifies linearity defect <=1 as weakly chordal with im<=2; G1/G5 lie outside or probe excess, G2 probes the linear boundary but the full numbers (46,59,40,14,2) are not implied by Froberg linearity alone. Hibi et al. (1412.3881) proves general im<=reg<=mmm bounds and dominating-matching case - provides the framing inequality verified here (1<=2,1<=1,2<=2,2<=2,1<=2,2<=2,3<=3) but no per-graph tables and no jump witness. Internal censuses SCOPE066 (5-7v) and SCOPE049 (6v + 7v sample) do not reach 8-10v. The relational fact reg(H+e)=reg(H)+1 alone is elementary disjoint-union additivity (H has isolated vertices 7,8; e={7,8} is a new K2 component, so reg adds by tensor product) and is not counted as novelty; novelty rests on the exact per-ideal graded tables which are not mechanically implied by the general bounds or family formulas.

value.rationale: Headline exact invariants are independently retrievable under the exact-invariant clause: objects were motivated before computation (G1 C5 blow-up probes non-chordal/non-weakly-chordal excess beyond defect<=1; G2 chordal K5-attachment probes linear-resolution boundary/equality; G3 whiskered C5 probes unmixed/CM region; intermediaries span the region; H/H+e probes single-edge behaviour), values were unknown and not mechanically implied (full tables, not just reg bounds), and a future researcher testing Katzman im<=reg, Herzog-Hibi-Zheng, or Kalai-Meshulam programs could need the precise tables as test data (e.g. G1 reg2 vs im1 excess 1 with top b8,10=1; G2 full linear strand 16,46,59,40,14,2; G5 reg2 vs im1; H 9v table; H+e 9v table with b6,9=2). Not a textbook restatement (no textbook lists these tables), not mere parameter substitution, not a bare tiny increment (jump is accompanied by full tables and witnesses, and the trivial additivity mechanism is disclosed as limitation rather than structural discovery). Incomplete-census concern does not erase the headline exact tables; no all-graphs maximality is claimed.
